vision.name: Orange Combative Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your opponent's attacks deal -1 stage of damage. Your Styled energy attacks gain "HIT: Prevent 3 stages and 3 life cards of damage from your opponent's attacks in their next action this combat."
POWER: Gain 2 stages. Choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it. If that card is a Styled Drill, you may place it into play instead.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; number reads DR20
